identification: French Louis XV style walnut/fruitwood table de nuit (bedside cabinet), c1890-1910, 86 x 39 x 35 cm. Shaped white/grey-veined marble top with moulded edge, frieze drawer with carved scroll cartouche and knob, door with bookmatched/quarter-veneered panel in a moulded cartouche frame, interior lined with pale marble slab sides/base (typical pot cupboard), shaped apron, four tall slender carved cabriole legs with leaf-carved knees and scroll toes. Old finish with wear; colour faded light. Single cabinet, not a pair. Estimate 150-200, current bid about A$80-85 (next increment 90).
